newsitem.title: USA: Meridian Q4 property damage claims higher.
newsitem.headline: Meridian Q4 property damage claims higher.

text.p: Meridian Insurance Group Inc said Thursday that higher expenses from property damage claims contributed to a decline in earnings in the 1996 fourth quarter.
Net income fell to $2.7 million, or $0.40 a share, from $4.2 million, or $0.62 a share, a year earlier.
The company said losses and loan adjustment expenses increased to $35.3 million in the quarter from $22.3 million a year ago.
Total revenues rose to $52.9 million from $40.1 million.
Meridian Insurance Group provides a variety of insurance products in 13 states.
Its shares were unchanged at 15-1/2 in early afternoon trading.
